fusions.name: Pocketed Pebble
fusions.desc: Flicks a pebble that deals 4 damage. Each hit has a 20% chance to leave the target [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Prised Keystone
fusions.desc: Wrenches out a keystone that deals 16 damage, consuming every affliction on the target and adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the blow. It only strikes a target at or below 25% health, and that threshold rises with each rank.

fusions.name: Cliff Scramble
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% and your dodge chance by 15% for 10 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Rehearsed Handholds
fusions.desc: Every time you land a critical hit, a stack builds on you, up to 10. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 3% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
